findings.title: Security group allows ingress from the internet to sensitive ports
findings.remediation:
Restrict the source to known CIDR ranges or another security group, and reach instances through SSM Session Manager or a bastion instead of exposing admin ports.

ingress {
  from_port   = 22
  to_port     = 22
  protocol    = "tcp"
  cidr_blocks = ["10.20.0.0/16"]
}

findings.title: IAM role can be assumed by any principal
findings.message: Trust policy allows Principal "*" without a condition
findings.remediation: Trust specific accounts, roles or services, and require sts:ExternalId or aws:PrincipalOrgID conditions for cross-account access.

findings.title: IAM policy grants full administrator access
findings.remediation: Grant only the actions and resources the workload needs. IAM Access Analyzer can generate a least-privilege policy from CloudTrail activity.

findings.title: S3 bucket ACL grants public access
S3 bucket policy allows access from any principal
findings.message: Statement allows s3:GetObject to Principal "*" with no condition
findings.remediation: Name the specific AWS principals that need access, or add a Condition (for example aws:SourceVpce, aws:PrincipalOrgID or aws:SourceArn) that narrows who can use the statement.

findings.title: RDS instance is publicly accessible
findings.remediation: publicly_accessible = false

findings.title: RDS storage is not encrypted
findings.remediation:
storage_encrypted = true
kms_key_id        = aws_kms_key.rds.arn  # optional customer managed key

findings.title: AdministratorAccess managed policy is attached
findings.remediation: Attach a scoped customer managed policy instead, and reserve administrator access for break-glass roles protected by MFA.

findings.title: EKS API endpoint is open to the internet
S3 bucket is not covered by a full public access block
findings.message: Public access block aws_s3_bucket_public_access_block.assets leaves block_public_acls, block_public_policy disabled
findings.remediation:
resource "aws_s3_bucket_public_access_block" "this" {
  bucket                  = aws_s3_bucket.this.id
  block_public_acls       = true
  block_public_policy     = true
  ignore_public_acls      = true
  restrict_public_buckets = true
}

findings.title: S3 bucket is not covered by a full public access block
findings.message: No aws_s3_bucket_public_access_block is attached to this bucket
findings.remediation:
resource "aws_s3_bucket_public_access_block" "this" {
  bucket                  = aws_s3_bucket.this.id
  block_public_acls       = true
  block_public_policy     = true
  ignore_public_acls      = true
  restrict_public_buckets = true
}

EBS storage is not encrypted

findings.title: RDS automated backups are disabled
findings.remediation: backup_retention_period = 7  # or longer

findings.title: IAM policy uses service-wide wildcard actions
findings.remediation: List the specific actions needed, for example ["s3:GetObject", "s3:PutObject"] instead of "s3:*".

findings.title: KMS key rotation is disabled
findings.remediation: enable_key_rotation = true

findings.title: CloudTrail trail is not multi-region
findings.remediation: is_multi_region_trail = true

findings.title: CloudTrail log file validation is disabled
findings.remediation: enable_log_file_validation = true

findings.title: Load balancer listener serves plain HTTP
findings.message: HTTP listener does not redirect to HTTPS

findings.title: Load balancer listener allows TLS 1.0 or 1.1
findings.remediation: ssl_policy = "ELBSecurityPolicy-TLS13-1-2-2021-06"

findings.title: Lambda function URL has no authentication
findings.remediation: authorization_type = "AWS_IAM"  # or suppress with a reason if public by design
findings.suppression_reason: Public by design: Stripe webhook, payload signature is verified in code

findings.message: Versioning is not enabled for this bucket

findings.title: S3 bucket versioning is not enabled
findings.message: Versioning is not enabled for this bucket

findings.title: Instance gets a public IP address
findings.remediation: Remove associate_public_ip_address (or set it to false) and place the instance in a private subnet.

findings.title: IAM policy is attached directly to a user
findings.message: Policy is attached to an IAM user instead of a group or role
findings.remediation: Attach the policy to an aws_iam_group and add the user to the group, or move humans to IAM Identity Center.

findings.title: CloudTrail logs are not encrypted with a KMS key
findings.remediation: kms_key_id = aws_kms_key.cloudtrail.arn

findings.title: SQS queue encryption is disabled
findings.message: sqs_managed_sse_enabled is false and no KMS key is set
findings.remediation: Remove sqs_managed_sse_enabled = false, or set kms_master_key_id.
